evidence.detail: Test confirms 'librarians' + colors ['U'] → 'Mono Blue Librarians'; the mapping is name/color-based, not card-content-based
Academy Loremaster does not appear anywhere in deck classification or archetype assignment code — no card-requirement system exists
add_archetype_if_just_colors only checks color combinations; no card-content validation is performed

triage.notes: Decision needed: (a) add a card-requirement field to archetypes so classification can be validated against maindeck contents, or (b) treat this as a one-time admin reclassification of the affected decks. Option (a) is a meaningful schema and feature addition; option (b) requires no code.
